newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Platinum jumps in Europe as supply jitters linger.
newsitem.headline: Platinum jumps in Europe as supply jitters linger.

text.p: Platinum extended its gains in nervous trading, underpinned by continuing uncertainty about Russian deliveries, dealers said.
Platinum jumped to $419.00/423.00 from $401.10/$402.10 at the London close.
The dearth of physical supplies of platinum and palladium was keeping the market edgy, he said.
Palladium was quoted at $194.00/$197.00 versus $196.00/$197.00 in London.
One analyst said the market would remain nervous until Russian deliveries were confirmed.
"They have said before they would start and nothing happened," he said. "Prices will only calm down when news comes from Japan that the first deliveries have arrived."

Gold firmed to $345.70/$346.10 from the London close at $344.80/$345.30. Trading was quiet, with the spat between the German government and the Bundesbank over Bonn's plan to revalue gold reserves having little impact on the market, dealers said.
Silver edged up two cents to $4.73/$4.75 in quiet business. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
